summary: Cresud S.A.C.I.F. y A. furnished a 6-K containing an English translation of a payment notice for its Series XLVII 7.00% fixed-rate notes, principal USD 64,417,023 due 2028. The fourth semiannual interest installment of USD 2,273,126.73 covers the period May 15 to November 15, 2026, payable November 16, 2026 in USD through paying agent Caja de Valores S.A. to holders of record November 13, 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural change is disclosed; this is a routine debt-service notice, not a special situation, with no risk-arb angle.
